pyongyang.title: North Korea fires multiple ballistic missiles towards the sea
detail: North Korea fired a suspected ballistic missile off its east coast Monday, days after warning Seoul of retaliation if its territory were violated. (Bloomberg)

North Korea has fired an unidentified projectile off its east coast, Seoul’s military said on Monday. “North Korea fires unidentified projectile into the East Sea,” the Joint Chiefs of Staff said in a brief statement, referring to the body of water also known as the Sea of Japan. (South China Morning Post)

pyongyang.title: N. Korea capable of overwhelming US homeland missile defense – expert
detail: North Korea has greatly advanced its nuclear and missile capabilities since its first nuclear test 20 years ago, potentially to a level that could overwhelm the United States’ homeland missile defense and create challenges for its Asian allies, according to a former U.S. intelligence analyst. (Inquirer)

pyongyang.title: Suspected North Korean land mine found on Incheon beach
detail: An antipersonnel land mine believed to have washed ashore from North Korea was discovered on a beach in Ganghwa-gun, Incheon, last Thursday, prompting authorities to urge residents and visitors to exercise caution. According to Ganghwa officials on Friday, the mine was found around 3:20 p.m. (Inquirer)

pyongyang.title: Two Koreas clash at UN over DMZ mine blasts
detail: South and North Korea clashed at the United Nations last Thursday over recent land mine explosions in the Demilitarized Zone, with Seoul accusing Pyongyang of violating the Armistice Agreement and demanding an apology while the North denies responsibility. South Korean Ambassador to the UN Cha Ji-hoon raised the Sept. (Inquirer)

pyongyang.title: Denuclearising North Korea would ‘defy history’ as US, allies missed the boat
detail: The denuclearisation of North Korea has become an “increasingly improbable” goal and the United States and its allies should move beyond it to devote their diplomatic efforts to talks on arms limitations and crisis communication, the director of the US-based North Korean analysis website 38 North said. (South China Morning Post)

pyongyang.title: South Korea test-flies its first domestically developed hypersonic weapon
detail: The test follows North Korea's recent hypersonic missile test. Tensions between the Koreas have increased after land mine explosions injured three South Korean soldiers near the border. North Korea denies responsibility. (NPR World)

pyongyang.title: South Korea to recall ambassador from Ukraine amid POW dispute
detail: South Korea said on Thursday it would recall its ambassador to Ukraine in response to a deepening diplomatic row over the transfer of North Korean prisoners of war to Seoul. (South China Morning Post)

Seoul said Kyiv's public disclosure of the repatriation of two North Korean prisoners endangered their families in North Korea, where relatives of those who fall into enemy hands face punishment. Ukraine has rejected South Korea's accusations. (Euronews)

singapore.title: LOOK: Marcos, Singapore PM Wong meet at Formula 1 Grand Prix
detail: SINGAPORE — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and Singapore Prime Minister Lawrence Wong met on the sidelines of the Formula 1 Singapore Grand Prix on Sunday as the Philippine leader wrapped up his five-day working visit to the city-state. (Inquirer)

singapore.title: Singapore rolls out haze subsidies as Malaysia extends school closures
detail: Singapore again ranked as the world’s most polluted city on Monday, according to Swiss-based air quality monitor IQAir, as the fires on Borneo and Sumatra islands – intensified by a turbocharged El Nino weather phenomenon – keep emitting toxic haze. (South China Morning Post)

SINGAPORE — Singapore rolled out subsidies for haze-related medical treatment Monday and schools were closed in parts of neighboring Malaysia, as both countries grapple with persistently unhealthy air quality due to fires in nearby Indonesia. (Inquirer)

singapore.title: Verstappen captures first Singapore Grand Prix on 10th attempt
detail: Red Bull's Verstappen held the lead throughout the race after he held off Ferrari's Charles Leclerc in the first corner. (The Japan Times)

singapore.title: Piastri suffers tyre puncture, Verstappen roars to Singapore F1 win
detail: Oscar Piastri battles to a hard-fought fifth place at the Singapore Grand Prix, helping his McLaren team salvage some pride and useful championship points from an otherwise frustrating weekend at the Marina Bay Street Circuit. (ABC News (AU))

singapore.title: Indonesia welcomes Singapore, Malaysia offers to help tackle haze
detail: JAKARTA – Indonesian officials welcomed offers of assistance from Singapore and Malaysia to tackle forest and land fires that have sent haze blanketing the region, with one disaster management official saying firefighters on the ground could be more useful than helicopters. (Inquirer)

singapore.title: The hidden heartbreak of losing a pet in Singapore and Malaysia
detail: Growing up in a Malay family in Singapore, Hafeez Hassan feared dogs. He never expected to mourn one like a sibling. “Maybe that is what I have been grieving all along … The experience of loving something that I was taught I was not supposed to love,” he said. (South China Morning Post)

singapore.title: Hong Kong hiker dies, Singaporean teen discharged after 2 trail emergencies
detail: A Singaporean girl has been flown to a hospital after falling ill during a hike with two other friends at Hong Kong’s Lion Rock, according to police. The force received a report on Saturday from the mother of one of the hikers at about 6.50am. (South China Morning Post)

singapore.title: Verstappen wins chaotic Singapore GP F1 sprint after Russell crashes

detail: Hotelier Sherap Gurung of Lokpa, the gateway village and permit checkpoint for the popular Tsum Valley trekking area in northern Gorkha district, woke early on Sunday to a growing rumble from the Syarkhola stream below his house. (Inquirer)

detail: At the compound of the District Coordination Committee in Bidur, Nuwakot around two weeks ago, flood survivors rummaged through piles of relief supplies, picking out what they needed. Some picked up plates, bowls and water jugs. Others reached for cooking pans and ladles. (Inquirer)

kathmandu.title: Nepal: Flood destroyed homes, but power utility still bills victims
detail: KATHMANDU — Flood-displaced people in Rasuwa, Nuwakot, and Dhading districts say they are still receiving electricity bills with VAT and penalties. The Bhotekoshi flood on August 26 swept away homes, businesses, and farmland along the Bhotekoshi-Trishuli river corridor in Rasuwa, Nuwakot and Dhading. (Inquirer)

nuuk.title: Greenlanders Still Seek Independence After US Deal
detail: Greenland’s push for independence remains firmly on the agenda after its new security deal with the US, according to the island’s lawmakers. (Bloomberg)
